title: cleome augustinensis
intro: Cleome augustinensis, commonly known as Spider Flower or Love Flower, is a species of flowering plant in the Cleomaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and skin disorders, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions, including reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against oxidative stress, primarily through its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins. These constituents contribute to the plant's potential in providing relief from pain, itching, and redness, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
